final: SELECT AVG(avg_units) as final_avg_units, AVG(avg_diff) as final_avg_diff, AVG(diff_from_overall) as final_avg_diff_from_overall FROM (WITH grouped AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_units, AVG(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) as avg_diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY product_type_description), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) as overall_avg FROM grouped), filtered AS (SELECT g.product_type_description, g.avg_units, g.avg_diff, g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg as diff_from_overall FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_diff > o.overall_avg) SELECT avg_units, avg_diff, diff_from_overall FROM filtered)
